The Stoney Lake example study, read, checked and filtered

Source: R/data.R
stoney_clean.Rd

The detection set that vignette("detqc") builds from the Stoney Lake files: read and joined with detset(), sensors converted with calibrate_sensors(), checked with check_detset() and the depth raster, audited with audit_listening() before the filters, with every receiver named as working, then filter_duplicates(), filter_post_release() (6 h), filter_min_lag() (4,500 s), the reviewer's calls stored with apply_mortality_calls() (ST-02 dead or shed at 02:00 UTC on 4 June 2024, the other three alive) and filter_mortality() with margin_days = 1. Of the 3,297 detections read, 1,938 are left. Use it to try the exports and the processing report without rerunning the steps.

Usage

stoney_clean

Format

A detset with 1,938 detections of 4 animals, 20 deployments, 180 receiver-days in listening, the results of 29 checks in checks, 4 calls in mortality and 9 records in log. The file names it records, in meta$sources and in the source attribute of each table, are kept without their folders.

Source

Built by https://github.com/jakebrownscombe/detqc/blob/main/data-raw/stoney_clean.R, which is in the repository and not in the installed package.

Examples

stoney_clean
#> <detset> 1,938 detections of 4 animals (4 transmitters), heard on 14 of 20
#>   receivers at 14 of 20 stations
#>   2024-06-02 to 2024-06-10 (UTC); 20 deployments; 4 animal rows; 180 of 180
#>     receiver-days listening (audited)
#>   log: 9 steps (detset, calibrate_sensors, check_detset, audit_listening,
#>     filter_duplicates, filter_post_release, filter_min_lag,
#>     apply_mortality_calls, filter_mortality)
#>   mortality calls: 4 animals
detset_log(stoney_clean)[, c("step", "rows_before", "rows_after")]
#>                    step rows_before rows_after
#> 1                detset        3297       3297
#> 2     calibrate_sensors        3297       3297
#> 3          check_detset        3297       3297
#> 4       audit_listening        3297       3297
#> 5     filter_duplicates        3297       3297
#> 6   filter_post_release        3297       3191
#> 7        filter_min_lag        3191       3148
#> 8 apply_mortality_calls        3148       3148
#> 9      filter_mortality        3148       1938
